tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background behind the HUD. Text colors text-primary, text-secondary and text-muted all read on it.

tokens.name: panel-bg
tokens.usage: HUD panels, roster cards, dialogs. Text colors read on it; borders use panel-border.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, selected roster rows, table headers inside panels. Text colors read on it.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: 1px control and panel borders. 3:1 against panel-bg and bg so containers are visible without shade alone.

tokens.name: world-floor
tokens.usage: Walkable floor planks or tiles in the 3D world. Never used for text.

tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: Wall faces and doorframes in the world. Never used for text.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Desks, shelves, doors, signposts. Base of the 4-step wood ramp.

tokens.name: metal
tokens.usage: Monitor frames, lamps, filing cabinets, hinges. Base of the metal ramp.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Report sheets, notes, signs, evidence mats in the world.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, working state, active toolbar tool. Turquoise. Pair with on-fill when used as a fill.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis, reviewing state, brand brass, links. Pair with on-fill when used as a fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed state and passed checks. Always shown with a check icon and the word Completed.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Waiting state and cautions. Always with an hourglass or triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked state. Always with a lock icon and the word Blocked. Never confused with failed.

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Failed state and error banners. Always with an X icon and the word Failed.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selection outline and corner brackets on agents, rooms and objects. Shape (brackets) carries the meaning too.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The LIVE mode chip and bridge-connected dot. Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: demo
tokens.usage: Demo mode banner, diagonal stripe edge and DEMO chip. Used for nothing else.

tokens.name: offline
tokens.usage: Offline bridge banner, offline state, crossed-out monitor. Always with a slash icon and the word Offline.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Agent names, titles, body copy on bg, panel-bg and panel-raised.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Roles, labels, secondary body on bg, panel-bg and panel-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, timestamps, placeholders on bg, panel-bg and panel-raised. Still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on solid state, accent and status fills (badges, primary buttons).

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: Idle state color. Shown with a z icon and the word Idle.

tokens.name: state-planning
tokens.usage: Planning state color. Shown with a compass icon and the word Planning.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Pixel outline around sprites and props: 1 texel dark warm brown, never pure black.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px ring plus 2px outline-colored gap ring so it holds on any ground. 3:1 on panel-bg, bg and world floor.

tokens.name: evidence-frame
tokens.usage: The paper-colored frame and tab around approved screenshots and real reports, drawn on screen-bg inside monitors. Decorative content never uses it.

tokens.name: screen-bg
tokens.usage: Inside every in-world monitor. Dark in all themes.

tokens.name: screen-text
tokens.usage: Text on screen-bg inside monitors.

tokens.name: screen-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text on screen-bg: timestamps, placeholders.

tokens.name: redacted-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the hidden-personal-data placeholder, under the diagonal hatch.

tokens.name: redacted-mark
tokens.usage: Hatch lines and the eye-slash icon on redacted placeholders. 4.5:1 on redacted-bg.

tokens.name: agent-alpha
tokens.usage: Player Alpha identity color: hat band, selection tint, roster stripe. Never the only identifier.

tokens.name: agent-explorer
tokens.usage: Explorer identity color. Never the only identifier.

tokens.name: agent-analyst
tokens.usage: QA Analyst identity color. Never the only identifier.

tokens.name: agent-critic
tokens.usage: Design Critic identity color. Never the only identifier.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: Working state color. Shown with a gear icon and the word Working.

tokens.name: state-waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting state color. Alias of warning.

tokens.name: state-reviewing
tokens.usage: Reviewing state color. Shown with a magnifier icon and the word Reviewing.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: Blocked state color. Alias of blocked.

tokens.name: state-completed
tokens.usage: Completed state color. Alias of success.

tokens.name: state-failed
tokens.usage: Failed state color. Alias of failed.

tokens.name: state-offline
tokens.usage: Offline state color. Alias of offline.

tokens.name: state-demo
tokens.usage: Demo state color. Alias of demo.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: App title in the top bar and empty-state headlines. One per screen. Pixelify Sans; never below 20px.

styles.name: room-title
styles.usage: Room panel heading and in-world room sign overlays (max 16 characters in the world).

styles.name: agent-name
styles.usage: Agent name in roster, selected-agent panel and in-world name tag (max 12 characters in the world).

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Status badge text, uppercase, always next to an icon. Max 10 characters in the world.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, toolbar tooltips, table headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Panel body copy and event descriptions. Atkinson Hyperlegible for legibility; never a pixel font.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and finding titles.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, monitor footers. 12px is the minimum size anywhere.

styles.name: log
styles.usage: Event log lines and monitor safe-text activity. Truncate, never wrap, in the world.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Timestamps beside every event and monitor. 24-hour clock with offset.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: One art pixel at 1x zoom. Icon-to-text gap inside badges is 6px, not a token.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons and inside compact rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding and gap between list items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard panel gutter and viewport gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between HUD regions on desktop wide.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Reserved safe margin around the world canvas so the HUD never covers scene edges.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: World-adjacent frames, monitors, selection brackets: square like pixels.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the world viewport frame.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: HUD panels and dialogs: a hard 2px drop, never a blur.

tokens.name: shadow-pixel
tokens.usage: Pressed-out buttons and the selected agent card. Hard offset only.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every HUD control: inner gap ring in the ground color, outer solid ring in focus-ring. Holds on panels, bg and world.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Pressed feedback and hover tint.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Selection brackets, badge swaps, tooltip.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panel open, tab swap, monitor mode change.

tokens.name: duration-camera
tokens.usage: Camera focus and zoom steps (eased, then snapped to the texel grid).

tokens.name: duration-report
tokens.usage: Report-complete paper settle. Plays once per real completion event.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: HUD and camera movement.

tokens.name: ease-pixel
tokens.usage: Sprite and badge frame stepping so motion stays pixel-crisp.

tokens.name: texel-scale
tokens.usage: CSS pixels per art texel at 1x zoom. Zoom steps are whole multiples: 1x, 2x, 3x.

tokens.name: tile-texels
tokens.usage: One world grid tile is 16 by 16 texels.

tokens.name: sprite-width
tokens.usage: Character sprite width in texels (one tile).

tokens.name: sprite-height
tokens.usage: Character sprite height in texels (one and a half tiles).

tokens.name: camera-elevation
tokens.usage: Orthographic camera elevation: gives the 2:1 pixel-art diamond.

tokens.name: camera-azimuth
tokens.usage: Orthographic camera heading in v1 (fixed).

tokens.name: render-height
tokens.usage: Internal render target height; upscaled by whole numbers (4x to 1080p).

tokens.name: sprite-fps
tokens.usage: Frames per second for sprite animation. Idle breathing steps at 2.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target for HUD controls and world hit areas.
